candidates.title: Make the five size options real buttons
candidates.rationale: The sizes are clickable <div>s, which cannot take focus. Real buttons are reachable with Tab, so keyboard users can finish, and are announced as buttons.

candidates.title: Name the cart button “Cart”
candidates.rationale: The icon-only button has no accessible name, so a screen reader announces just “button”. A name tells the user what it does.

candidates.title: Add a “Skip to main content” link
candidates.rationale: Every visit starts with 78 header and navigation stops. A skip link jumps past all of them with one keystroke.

patch.after:
Skip to main content
…

candidates.title: Make “Customer reviews” a level-2 heading
candidates.rationale: It is styled like a heading but is a plain <div>, so heading navigation skips it. Real headings give screen-reader users landmarks to jump between.

candidates.title: Make “Free returns” a level-2 heading
candidates.rationale: Same pattern: a visual heading that assistive technology cannot see. Promoting it puts the returns policy one keypress away.

candidates.title: Wrap the page content in <main>
candidates.rationale: Without a main landmark, landmark navigation cannot jump to the content. Small gain, since a skip link does the same job.
